trigger_applet.description: Fire a Webhooks event with up to three values, which runs every applet whose trigger is Webhooks' Receive a web request for that event name. The applet reads the values as Value1 to Value3.

mock_response.message: Congratulations! You've fired the front_door_opened event

trigger_applet.name: trigger_applet

parameters.description: The event name in your applet's Webhooks trigger, exactly as typed there, such as front_door_opened. Every applet listening for it runs.
parameters.name: event_name

parameters.description: Text the applet can use as its Value1 ingredient. Left out when blank.
parameters.name: value1

parameters.description: Text the applet can use as its Value2 ingredient. Left out when blank.
parameters.name: value2

parameters.description: Text the applet can use as its Value3 ingredient. Left out when blank.
parameters.name: value3

message.description: IFTTT's answer, such as "Congratulations! You've fired the front_door_opened event". It comes whether or not an applet listens.

sent.description: The values sent, value1 to value3

trigger_applet_with_json.description: Fire a Webhooks event with any JSON object, which runs every applet whose trigger is Webhooks' Receive a web request with a JSON payload for that event name. The applet reads it in its filter code.

mock_response.message: Congratulations! You've fired the front_door_opened event

trigger_applet_with_json.name: trigger_applet_with_json

parameters.description: The event name in your applet's Webhooks trigger, exactly as typed there, such as front_door_opened. Every applet listening for it runs.
parameters.name: event_name

parameters.description: A JSON object to send, such as {"temperature": 21, "room": "kitchen"}, or an object from an earlier step.
parameters.name: payload

message.description: IFTTT's answer, such as "Congratulations! You've fired the front_door_opened event". It comes whether or not an applet listens.

description: Run your IFTTT applets from a workflow by firing a Webhooks event, with up to three values or any JSON object.
